sentences.en: Babies grow up inside the amniotic fluid in the womb.
sentences.zh: 婴儿在子宫内的羊水中成长。

sentences.en: Blood is the fluid responsible for the circulation of nutrients.
sentences.zh: 血液负责营养物质的循环。

sentences.en: The concept of resistance is just as applicable in fluids.
sentences.zh: 阻力的概念在流体中同样适用。

senses.zh: 流动的；不固定的，易变的；流畅的，优美的；液压传动的
